title: Unit Event — The Phoenix in the Distant Sky — Episode4 Her Talent

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky
meta.Event Outline: At the Otoris' suggestion, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are set to perform in the Phoenix Stage's 30th Anniversary Show. What's more, they'll be performing a show starred in by Tsukasa's idol. Tsukasa leaps at the chance to audition for the same role as him!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Goood morning!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're looking forward to working with you all today!!!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Ah, as peppy as ever, I see.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: We'll be practicing in earnest starting today. I know it's not going to be easy, but let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, let's. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
At first glance, things seem more or less the same as yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But there is also a hint of tension in the air. The atmosphere is just right for our first day of practice.)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Alright, we'll begin practicing for our production of “The Happy Phoenix” starting today.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: In the morning, we'll begin by covering the basics. In the afternoon, you'll be performing your respective parts in a readthrough.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Since the casting for Rio hasn't been decided yet, our candidates will be taking turns reading his lines. Please be sure to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: I know it won't be easy having them swap for each scene, but try to remain focused and in character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(We'll be taking turns, eh...?
Five people are vying for this role, so none of us will be getting much time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The director will surely be watching us during this time before the audition as well. I need to make sure my version of Rio really leaves an impression on him!)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Tenma...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-Wah!
Yes?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I know you're focused on winning this role, but basic training comes first. We usually begin by stretching, running and doing some strength exercises.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We also play some teambuilding games from time to time, but we'll mainly be working out today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Okay. Got it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I should be able to handle all of that!
After all, I have more stamina and a louder voice than most people.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
No, you don't seem to get it...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Remember what I said yesterday?
“We take things much more seriously than you may realize”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Once we're done stretching, we'll be going for a ten-minute run!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Ten minutes...?
We should be able to handle...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyway, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Hey, wait!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough warming up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Phew. That was good. I feel ready now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I can still keep running!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hmm... This doesn't seem so bad...
I feel like we all handled that just fine...)

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Okay! Next, we'll be running ten kilometers. Everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
T-Ten kilometers...?!
You call that basic?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?! That's not a run. That's pretty much a marathon...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Oh? We need you to be able to handle this much. I mean, some shows have everyone running around for two hours straight.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Or is this a bit too much?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, of course not...!
Especially since we always work on building up our stamina!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: By the way, after our run, we'll be doing strength training for an hour. Following that, we'll be working on our voices for an hour.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?! S-Strength training?! For an hour?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, since it's every actor's duty to be fit. Be it dancing or pantomiming, your body needs to be able to do as it's told.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Guh...!
Y-You're right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You guys exercise so much!
This is gonna be super fun, Nene!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know we only do up to two hours of exercising at most, Nene, but let's try to make the most of this opportunity and do our best here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Of course, we don't want you to get hurt or anything, so please don't hesitate to tell us if you think you're at your limit. Now, everyone, let's run!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose this will be our first rite of passage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Grr...! No one from the Phoenix Stage seems to be slowing down at all. I suppose it's no wonder since they do this every day...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (After all, stamina is vital in terms of staying in character and remaining focused on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've been building up my stamina as much as I could until now, but I should use this opportunity to take another big step forward...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa's going awfully fast.
I hope he doesn't exhaust himself partway through.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Where'd Nene go...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, she's way in the back!
Nene! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: Haha. A 10K right off the bat probably is a bit rough. But it's okay, just run at your own pace.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here, have some water!
Just keep trying! I know you can!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Okay, next...
A hundred squats. Make sure you maintain a good posture!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
No more... I'm done...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
My legs felt a little wobbly towards the end, but I did it!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Hey, not bad. Your technique's really good. Alright, let's do three sets of these...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
Three sets...?! That's 300 in total!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Yes, because having strong legs and hips has endless benefits! Especially when it comes to dancing and performing stunts!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So this is what it means to perform at the Phoenix Stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought that I'd been doing enough as an actor until now, but I'm honestly struggling to keep up with them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, next set!
One! Two! Three!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Since our leader is trying so hard, we should follow suit.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Take ten here.
After that, we'll begin our readthrough.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm done... Like really done...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oof... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me too...
My knees won't stop complaining.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That was just a morning training session and I already feel spent... Even Emu with her infinite stamina feels exhausted...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(And they do this every day...?
It's a good reminder of what the cast members of the Phoenix Stage are capable of...)

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a break, let's jump into our readthrough! Those who've been assigned a role, please gather on stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Let's head up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As I mentioned this morning, we'll be spending the afternoon on our readthrough. You're free to add in some movement, but be prepared to go through the entire show from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
As for Rio, well...
Why don't we go in order from left to right? Please jump in when it becomes your turn.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Kobayashi, you'll take the scene where he meets the phoenix for the first time. From page twenty-four, we'll have...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So I'll be starting from page fifty, where Rio and the phoenix start to understand one another's feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's a difficult scene, but I should be able to handle it. I've memorized every line and already know how I'm going to portray him...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm sure I'll do brilliantly...!)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Okay, let's start from page one... The scene where the phoenix appears for the first time before meeting Rio.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Sakurako, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Sakurako seems...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
She seems kinda different compared to normal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She must already be in character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Before saying a word, no less.
I'm quickly sensing the majestic aura of a phoenix emanating from her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She put on magnificent performances during the contest and night show... But Seiryuin seems completely different now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Now I see. I was too focused on her talent for singing before. On top of that, we had her play a minor part during the night show...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(She hasn't said a word.
If her presence is this strong now, what will she be like when she...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The opening scene of this show involves the phoenix making her initial appearance while a chorus of other birds gossip about her in a cheerful song...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Some show admiration for her and wish that they had her beauty, while others claim she's too snooty and that she has a heart of ice despite her flaming feathers.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And then, after all this anticipation's been built up and the audience's curiosity is piqued...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
As usual, day in and day out, this forest could not be more obnoxious.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No way...
Her voice is totally different...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But it also sounds natural...
It's like she's...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She's immersed herself into her character to the point that her voice is coming out different from normal.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(This sort of unearthly beauty...
The way she speaks almost in song is like...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Worst of all, I am unable to sleep the way I wish... And the way these trees shake is unbearable...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The way she moved her hand just now... It didn't seem like a hand. Rather, a wing batting away some leaves and branches...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Are my eyes playing tricks on me...?
But she's still a person...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “But moving is also out of the question since a normal forest would end up burning away in my presence.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “As such, I am only able to sleep in this magical wood. Could I be in a worse situation...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She's a phoenix...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've never seen a real one before, but she clearly looks like one to me now...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Is it the way she's moving...?
The subtle motions she's making as she recites her lines remind me of a bird...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “That creature over there looks unfamiliar. So small and helpless... How repulsive.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “It must be a human. A child at that.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “My hate for it knows no bounds.”

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A (As Rio)
rows.Line: “Huff... Huff...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...
This is where she meets Rio for the first time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (How is this part going to unfold...?)

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A (As Rio)
rows.Line: “I've been walking for ages now...”

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A (As Rio)
rows.Line: “This is definitely the forest where the witch is supposed to live, but I'm never going to find a phoenix at this rate...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, this portrayal of him will not do...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The atmosphere Seiryuin created is starting to fall apart a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This person isn't necessarily a bad actor. If anything, they're far better than average.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, showing up next to Seiryuin results in their portrayal feeling unnatural...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(In all likelihood...
This person is simply using all the tools at their disposal to play this boy.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (On the other hand, Seiryuin seems to have methodically approached her character by asking, “What do I need to do to play a phoenix properly?” There's quite a big chasm between them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This explains why no one has been selected for Rio yet...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Regardless... All that's left is for me to do what I can!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll show that my portrayal of Rio works best with Seiryuin's phoenix...!)
